# SnapReelDownload
> Free online video downloader for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and more.

SnapReelDownload is a free, browser-based tool that saves publicly available social media videos for personal offline viewing. No app installation, no account required. Works on iPhone, Android, Windows, and Mac.

## Purpose
Help users download videos from public social media profiles in HD quality directly in their browser. Supports MP4 video and MP3/M4A audio extraction.

## Core Capabilities
- No app or extension required — works in any browser
- No login to any social platform required
- HD quality MP4 video downloads (up to 4K for YouTube)
- Audio-only extraction (MP3/M4A) for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram
- No watermark on TikTok downloads
- Works on all devices: iPhone (Safari), Android (Chrome), desktop

## How to Use (all tools)
1. Copy the video link from the social media app (Share → Copy Link)
2. Paste the link into the input box on the relevant tool page
3. Click Download and select the quality (HD/SD/MP3)
4. The file saves to the device's Downloads folder or Camera Roll

## Platform-Specific Notes
- **Instagram**: works for public Reels, feed videos, Stories, and photos. Private accounts not supported.
- **TikTok**: downloads the original pre-watermark file. Creator must have public account.
- **YouTube**: supports up to 4K resolution and Shorts. Quality depends on what the creator uploaded.
- **Facebook**: supports public videos, Reels, Watch, and Group videos (public groups only).
- **iPhone**: always use Safari browser. Safari's download manager saves to Files; use Share → Save Video to move to Photos.
- **Android**: use Chrome. Downloads go to the Downloads folder and appear in Gallery automatically.

## Compliance
SnapReelDownload only processes publicly available content. It does not access private accounts, bypass authentication, or support content restricted by the platform. Intended for personal, non-commercial offline viewing. Users are responsible for respecting applicable copyright law and platform terms of service.
